# barcode-febraban

> npm packages that draw a Brazilian boleto barcode (ITF / Interleaved 2 of 5 / Febraban) from an even-length digit string, using the BarcodeInterleaved2of5 font. Published at 2.0.0 as @allansli/barcode-febraban-core, @allansli/angular-barcode-febraban (AngularJS 1.x), @allansli/react-barcode-febraban, @allansli/vue-barcode-febraban, and @allansli/ng-barcode-febraban (Angular 15+). Not EAN, UPC, or Code 128.

Pass a string of digits with even length, usually the 44-digit código de barras. A 47-digit linha digitável is odd, so it returns an empty barcode: these packages do not convert linha digitável and do not compute the módulo-11 DAC. npm ships the encoder and CSS only. Host BarcodeInterleaved2of5.ttf yourself.

Choose one package:

- Vanilla JS (`vanilla-core`): `@allansli/barcode-febraban-core` — `generateBarcodeSequence(digits)`
- AngularJS 1.x: `@allansli/angular-barcode-febraban` — `<ng-barcode-febraban barcode-sequence="...">`
- React 16.8+: `@allansli/react-barcode-febraban` — `<BarcodeFebraban sequence="..." />`
- Vue 3: `@allansli/vue-barcode-febraban` — `<BarcodeFebraban sequence="..." />`
- Angular 15+: `@allansli/ng-barcode-febraban` — `<barcode-febraban [sequence]="..."></barcode-febraban>`

`@allansli/angular-barcode-febraban` is AngularJS. `@allansli/ng-barcode-febraban` is Angular. Do not swap them.

## Docs

- [Monorepo README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/allansli/angular-barcode-febraban/master/README.md): Problem, install, minimal example, when to use and when not to use
- [Core README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/allansli/angular-barcode-febraban/master/packages/core/README.md): `@allansli/barcode-febraban-core` — `generateBarcodeSequence`, font, and CSS
- [AngularJS README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/allansli/angular-barcode-febraban/master/packages/angularjs/README.md): `@allansli/angular-barcode-febraban` directive
- [React README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/allansli/angular-barcode-febraban/master/packages/react/README.md): `@allansli/react-barcode-febraban` component
- [Vue README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/allansli/angular-barcode-febraban/master/packages/vue/README.md): `@allansli/vue-barcode-febraban` Vue 3 component
- [Angular README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/allansli/angular-barcode-febraban/master/packages/angular/README.md): `@allansli/ng-barcode-febraban` Angular 15+ component
- [Compact agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/allansli/angular-barcode-febraban/master/llms-full.txt): Install lines and one working snippet per package
